title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Twelve-week university internship. Train and evaluate ranking models in Python and PyTorch, improve feature pipelines, and present experiment results to ML engineers.

title: Research Engineer Intern
description: Student research internship investigating new privacy-preserving network algorithms. Design experiments, implement prototypes, analyze results, and contribute to a research publication.

title: Large Language Model Intern
description: Internship for a current computer science student. Fine-tune language models, build retrieval augmented generation evaluations, and measure model quality and safety.

title: NLP Engineering Intern
description: Summer internship developing text classification, entity extraction, and semantic search models. Implement experiments in Python and evaluate language datasets.

title: Computer Vision Intern
description: Student internship building image segmentation and object detection models for manufacturing inspection. Train neural networks and analyze visual datasets.

title: Robotics Software Intern
description: University placement implementing robot perception and motion-planning software. Integrate sensors, test autonomous navigation, and write C++ control code.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Six-month student placement building batch and streaming data pipelines, maintaining warehouse models, and improving ETL observability with Python and SQL.

title: Backend Software Engineer Intern
description: Summer internship writing server-side APIs and distributed services in Go. Design database queries, add automated tests, and review production telemetry.

title: Frontend Engineer Intern
description: Student internship building accessible React and TypeScript interfaces. Implement browser features, write component tests, and improve web performance.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: University co-op implementing React user interfaces and Python API services. Own features across the browser, backend, and relational database.

title: Cloud Platform Intern
description: Technical internship developing cloud-native services, container scheduling features, and distributed platform automation using Go and Kubernetes.

title: Infrastructure Engineering Intern
description: Student placement improving Linux networking systems, service reliability, capacity tooling, and distributed infrastructure performance.

title: Security Engineering Intern
description: Cybersecurity internship building threat-detection tooling, reviewing application vulnerabilities, and automating network security investigations in Python.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Student internship improving CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, service monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code used by engineering teams.

title: Embedded Software Intern
description: Engineering internship writing C firmware and device drivers for a real-time sensor platform. Debug hardware interfaces and create automated tests.

title: Mobile Application Intern
description: Summer software internship implementing native Android features in Kotlin, integrating APIs, and writing mobile unit and user-interface tests.

title: Sales Intern
description: Student internship qualifying sales leads, updating CRM records, preparing account plans, and supporting revenue targets. No programming responsibilities.

title: AI Innovation Intern - Service Sales
description: Commercial internship creating sales presentations for AI service offerings, researching prospects, and helping account executives close opportunities. This role does not build AI models or software.

title: Technology Marketing Intern
description: Internship planning campaigns for cloud products, writing social media copy, coordinating events, and reporting marketing engagement metrics. No engineering work.

title: Legal Intern
description: Student placement conducting legal research, reviewing commercial contracts, organizing case files, and supporting counsel with regulatory questions.

title: Finance Intern
description: University internship assisting with budgeting, financial forecasts, invoice reconciliation, and monthly management reporting.

title: Technical Recruiting Intern
description: Internship sourcing software candidates, scheduling interviews, maintaining applicant records, and supporting recruiting events. The role recruits engineers but does not write software.

title: Professional Services Intern
description: Customer services internship coordinating onboarding plans, documenting customer requirements, preparing presentations, and tracking service delivery. No hands-on engineering duties.

title: Business Development Representative
description: Permanent sales role generating pipeline, prospecting enterprise accounts, qualifying opportunities, and meeting quarterly revenue goals for cloud products.

title: Technical Account Manager
description: Permanent customer account role owning executive relationships, coordinating support escalations, managing renewals, and advising customers about technology products without implementing software.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description: Permanent experienced-hire position designing Go services and distributed databases. Requires six years of production engineering experience.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description: Permanent staff-level position leading production ML architecture and mentoring engineers. Requires eight years of machine learning experience.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description: Permanent full-time entry-level employment beginning after graduation. Build Java services as a salaried employee; this is not an internship or placement.

title: AI Product Manager
description: Permanent product role defining roadmap and commercial requirements for AI features, coordinating stakeholders, and prioritizing delivery. No model development or programming responsibilities.

title: Technology Litigation Counsel
description: Permanent legal position managing litigation, advising on regulatory risk, and coordinating external law firms for a software company.

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description: Permanent senior customer advisory role leading pre-sales workshops and solution proposals. Requires ten years of enterprise consulting experience and does not own production software.

title: Customer Success Intern
description: Student internship tracking customer adoption, arranging business reviews, documenting feedback, and helping customers use a software platform. No coding duties.
